# ROS2

This mod adds ROS2 to code-server and openvscode-server, to be installed/updated during container start.

Add it to the `code-server` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-ros2
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-ros2|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

## Details

The current release [ROS2 Humble](https://docs.ros.org/en/humble/) and its development tools will be made available inside the container.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/code-server-ros2/
